The '''Gundark Arms Ring''' was a group of [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealers]] led by an individual known as "[[Gundark (arms dealer)|Gundark]]." The group was active during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and into the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The Gundark Arms Ring posted its inventory via [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]], which could be accessed through the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]].<ref name="GFT" />
